messages:
Priya: Quick heads-up- sampled payloads from the canary show unhashed phone numbers in req bodies.
Noah: seriously? we have scrubbing for phone numbers on the pipeline. which route?
Priya: /v1/assist/stream (batch path). looks like sampler is doing its decision before scrub for batch_mode=true. sampler log: `sampler.decision=sampled pre-scrub`.
Jae: that's the pre-scrub-sampler interaction we thought we fixed. IIRC sampler currently attaches to relay output; batching code shortcuts that.
Tanya: Risk: stored samples with PII. Mitigation options: drop sample rate to near-zero for canary routes OR flip sampler ordering to post-scrub for affected routes.
Priya: Short-term: set sample_rate=0.0005 for canary assist routes and set `redact_profile=high`. Long-term: add per-route `post_scrub_sampling` flag and console toggle.
Noah: UX suggestion: call the toggle "Sample after redaction (recommended)" with a tiny info icon. Also show estimated sampled docs/day so owners understand impact.
Jae: Implementation note: post-scrub sampling requires the scrubber to run synchronously before sampler decision. That increases P99 latency ~1.5ms on the path. Is that acceptable?
Tanya: For canary yes. For heavy production routes maybe not. We should make it opt-in per-route.
Priya: Proposed quick config change payload: 
```
route=/v1/assist/stream
sample_rate=0.0005
post_scrub_sampling=true
redact_profile=high
```
Noah: Also add a router-side safety: `if (env==prod && route.meta.canary) sample_rate=min(sample_rate, 0.0005)`. prevents accidental ramp.
Jae: I'll add the guard into router evaluation; it's a 6-line change.
Tanya: Console work: include an "inspect" action but make it owner-only and show masked-preview (e.g. `+1-XXX-XXX-1234`) not raw. TTL 2h, and every preview is audited.
Priya: Masked-preview persistence means ephemeral storage. We should record who accessed preview and link to audit-id. Security ok?
Tanya: Security reviewed conceptually, wants audit spec before dev. I'll write the spec.
Noah: Monitoring: temporary alert `telemetry.sampled.pii_v1assist > 0` -> page SRE and notify #incidents. Also daily job to scan persisted samples for PII patterns.
Jae: I'll wire the alert and a lightweight PII-detector that looks for `\d{3}-\d{3}-\d{4}` and `@` in sampled payloads.
Priya: I'm opening PR #3612 (router guard) and INF-1001 (console toggle + preview + audit spec). Can someone pick console copy + tooltip?
Tanya: I'll take console copy and the audit spec. Will add tooltip: "When enabled, sampling happens after redaction so stored samples don't contain PII."
Noah: Figma mock: https://figma.com/file/rw-preview-mask (WIP).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: small sampler config deployed to staging at 2025-01-09T14:12:09Z :white_check_mark:
Priya: After staging verify, we'll roll to canary only and run the PII-scan for 48h.
Jae: Follow-ups: PR #3612, INF-1001, and a 1hr post-canary review.
Tanya: Thanks all.
